source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-21

procedures.title: Distributor contact points: opening specification
steps: Set new points to the larger gap, since the rubbing block wears in slightly against the cam.
Do not feeler-gauge rough or uncleaned used points; the reading is not accurate (see figure 8i in the manual).
Align points by bending the fixed contact support, never the breaker lever; replace used points that are badly misaligned.
notes: Points set too close burn and pit quickly; too wide gives a weak spark at high speed.

procedures.title: Dwell angle: set (V8 distributor)
steps: On the car, with the engine idling at normal operating temperature, lift the window in the cap and insert a hex-type wrench into the adjusting screw (see figure 11i in the manual).
Preferred: turn the screw until a dwell meter reads 28° to 32° (30° preferred).
Alternate (only without a meter): turn the screw clockwise until the engine starts to misfire, then back it 1/2 turn counterclockwise for an approximate setting.
